title: Every locally finite type morphism into a regular base scheme is perfect
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: For f : X -> S a morphism of schemes with S regular and f locally of finite type, f is perfect. The retained proof is the author's pointer 'See More on Algebra, lemma regular-perfect-ring-map': the algebraic statement that a finite-presentation map of rings landing over a regular ring is a perfect ring map (regular targets kill the Tor amplitude obstruction because residue fields have finite projective dimension), quoted by name; the scheme statement then reads chart by chart. Retained author proof at lines 17808-17811.
